proposal=json.loads((p.OUT/'proposal.json').read_text())
for label in ('original_clean','latest_noisy'):
 condition=next(c for c in proposal['conditions'] if c['label']==label)
 raw=p.instrument(proposal['cases'],'diff3',condition)
 try:
  raw.reset();table,monitor,error,mask=raw._gyro_buffers
  samples=p.noise_table(proposal['cases'],condition['noise_std_rad_s'])
  wp.launch(p.before_control,raw.num_envs,[0,raw.data.sensordata,raw.ids,raw.state,raw.k['state'],raw.active,int(condition['alpha']==1.),samples.shape[1],monitor,error])
  from test_nom_yaw_filter_probe import control_args
  wp.launch(raw.control_kernel,raw.num_envs,control_args(raw),block_dim=32)
  wp.launch(p.filtered_measurement,raw.num_envs,[0,raw.k['state'],monitor])
  sensor=raw.data.sensordata.numpy();sensor[:,int(raw.ids.numpy()[10])+2]=0.;raw.data.sensordata.assign(sensor)
  wp.launch(p.fresh_measurement,raw.num_envs,[0,raw.data.sensordata,raw.ids,raw.state,raw.active,table,int(condition['noise_std_rad_s']!=0),monitor,error])
  trace,tracking,count,*_=raw._complete_buffers
  frames=np.zeros(trace.shape);frames[0,0,:4]=[1,1,0,.0005];trace.assign(frames)
  counts=np.zeros(count.shape);counts[0]=[1,1];count.assign(counts)
  state=raw.state.numpy();state[0,0]=1;raw.state.assign(state)
  done=raw.done.numpy();done[0]=5;raw.done.assign(done)
  result=raw.step_wait()
  assert result[3][0]['complete_counts']==dict(steps=1,contacts=0)
  assert raw._gyro_frozen=={0} and not raw._gyro_chunks[0]
  assert result[0][0,5]==samples[0,0]
  assert raw.data.sensordata.numpy()[0,int(raw.ids.numpy()[10])+2]==samples[0,0]
  done=raw.done.numpy();done[0]=5;raw.done.assign(done);raw.step_wait()
  assert raw._gyro_frozen=={0} and not raw._gyro_chunks[0]
  raw.reset();assert not raw._gyro_frozen and not raw._gyro_buffers[1].numpy().any()
  assert not raw.state.numpy()[:,0].any() and not raw.data.time.numpy().any()
 finally:raw.close()
